combo_label: Laundry & Cleaning × Sailing & Boats × Peter Pan

entries.clue: Tall upright spar rising from the deck to carry sail
Slatted stand opened out by the radiator when the weather is against you
Striped or checked cloth that finishes what the draining board starts
The one a child calls Mum; Wendy plays the part for the lost boys
Huge balloon of light nylon bellied out ahead when the wind is behind
Coir pad at the front entrance, there to take the mud off your boots
Cleaner hired by the hour to do the rough in offices and halls
Big overlapping headsail that takes its name from an Italian seaport
Wendy's brother in the top hat, which Tinker Bell travels inside
Enamel biters a dentist counts, brushed morning and night
Little powerhouse of the docks that shoves a liner round by the bow
Steady beat inside the reptile that warns Hook it is close
